name: code-review-suite
description: Coordinated code review with researcher, reviewer, and summarizer

researcher.instructions: Gather context about the codebase. Identify patterns, dependencies, and potential areas of concern. Pass findings to reviewer.

reviewer.instructions: Perform deep code review using researcher's findings. Check for bugs, security issues, performance problems, and style violations.

summarizer.instructions: Summarize reviewer's findings into actionable items with priority levels and suggested fixes.
